definition: A pump, pump set, drive, or explicitly named pump-system equipment.
A physical component of a pump or its connected suction, discharge, sealing, lubrication, drive, valve, or pipe system.
An observable or diagnosable failure state.
A physical process through which degradation or failure develops.
A measured or computed diagnostic feature.
A stated initiating cause that is not merely a component name.
A load, pressure, temperature, flow, speed, medium, or environmental condition.
A named diagnostic or inspection method.
A concrete inspection or verification action.
A concrete repair, adjustment, cleaning, replacement, or preventive-maintenance action.
A standard, rule, guide, specification, or acceptance criterion.
A stated adverse consequence or risk state.
